about: Yaroslavl International Airport Zolotoe Koltso in Tunoshna. Runway 3,010 × 44 m. There is an air border crossing point and a customs post.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Bus 183 runs daily from Yaroslavl bus station to the airport. Journey time 40 minutes. The first trip from the bus station is at 05:50, the last from the airport at 22:35.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Premium comfort lounge for departing passengers. Inside: TV, Wi‑Fi, tea table, newspapers. Price 2,500 ₽ per passenger. Enquiries: +7 (4852) 43-18-00.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: The room for passengers with children is in the departure hall, airside. Admits passengers with children or disabled children under 14 with a boarding pass. Free, up to 3 hours before departure during the day and up to 4 hours at night. There is no room in the arrivals hall.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Paid car park, 300 ₽ per day. No booking or prepayment; pay when parking, subject to availability. The time to collect the car is agreed by phone 43-18-00.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi‑Fi is available in the terminal.
